name: Navigation Capsule 2.1
semanticRole: Primary reachable destination navigation that preserves destination identity while adapting representation across form factors.

input.keyboard: Every destination is reachable in logical order; activation uses native button/link semantics and must not depend on pointer behavior.
input.focus: Focus remains strongly visible and distinct from selection. Focus order follows logical destination order and is preserved through responsive transformations.
input.hover: Pointer hover may strengthen boundary, tint, or depth without becoming the only indication of availability or selection.
input.press: Press may contract slightly, increase optical density, and shift a bounded highlight toward the interaction point; activation must remain immediate.
input.selection: The active destination may expand and expose a label while inactive destinations remain compact; selection remains communicated through more than color alone.
input.directional: TV/remote focus uses a Focus Dock representation with strong visible focus, large targets, and deterministic directional traversal.
input.directManipulation: Forward reading/scrolling may compress the capsule and reverse scrolling may restore it when the behavior does not hide critical navigation or create focus instability.

motion.reducedMotionAlternative: Use immediate or short-fade state changes with no large translation, zoom, or morph while preserving selection and focus continuity.

accessibility.semantics: Expose a navigation landmark/container and native destination semantics, current destination state, accessible names, and deterministic reading/focus order.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Disable large capsule translation/morphing and use direct or short-fade state changes without changing navigation semantics.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Replace translucent material with a deliberately tuned opaque or tonal Surface/Soft Glaze equivalent while retaining hierarchy and boundaries.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen text, boundaries, focus, selected state, and separation without flattening the destination hierarchy.
accessibility.largeText: Allow labels to reflow, enlarge destinations, or transform to a roomier navigation representation rather than clip or shrink text.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system colors and explicit focus/selection boundaries while preserving native navigation semantics.
accessibility.showBoundaries: Strengthen destination and container boundaries without altering destination order or meaning.
accessibility.touchAssistance: Increase hit regions independently of visible capsule geometry and maintain safe-area separation.

fallbacks.material: Advanced Glaze may reduce through Simplified Glaze to Tonal Surface or Solid Surface while retaining navigation hierarchy and boundaries.
fallbacks.motion: Connected transform may reduce through restrained movement to fade or immediate state change while preserving focus and selection.
fallbacks.performance: Disable expensive background sampling, refraction, lighting, or continuous material response before reducing legibility, target size, or navigation availability.

nativeMappings.android: Use platform-native navigation primitives and accessibility semantics where appropriate while preserving Glaze destination identity, reachability, focus, material fallback, and form-factor transformation.
nativeMappings.linux: Use toolkit-native navigation/focus semantics while preserving Glaze hierarchy, keyboard behavior, density, and adaptive representation.
nativeMappings.web: Use semantic navigation and link/button primitives with keyboard/focus correctness; enhanced material and connected transitions remain progressive enhancement.
nativeMappings.tv: Use deterministic directional focus and far-view geometry; do not depend on hover or touch.

criteria: selected and inactive destinations are optically balanced
capsule proportions feel calm rather than oversized or cramped
material use remains restrained against surrounding content
icon and label baselines are optically aligned
compression and restoration feel connected rather than distracting
focus remains beautiful and unmistakable in every appearance/accessibility mode
larger-screen transformations retain the same product identity
opticalNotes: Icon glyph boxes may require small optical offsets inside equal mathematical frames.
Selected-label expansion may use bounded asymmetric padding when equal padding appears visually unbalanced.
